findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 Features in Research Commands

evidence.observation: TODO markers indicate missing Phase 5 authorization checking via Supabase, memory integration, and placeholder command implementations.

proposed_action.description: Implement Phase 5 authorization checking and integration with memory services or raise appropriate NotImplementedError until implemented.

findings.expected_benefit: Completes core command functionality and removes placeholder code paths.

findings.title: Unimplemented Quality Anomalies Query in Forecasting Engine

evidence.observation: recent_anomalies is hardcoded as empty list with TODO to query quality_anomalies table.

proposed_action.description: Implement query against quality_anomalies table in Supabase/storage to retrieve actual anomaly data.

findings.expected_benefit: Enables actual anomaly analysis instead of defaulting to an empty list.

findings.title: Model Router Call Log Missing

evidence.observation: Model router status reports router is reachable and active, but call_log_exists is false for /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl.

proposed_action.description: Ensure the model router logging directory exists and log handler creates call_log.jsonl on invocation.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores model call auditability, latency tracking, and operational metrics collection.

findings.title: Direct LLM API Invocation Bypassing Model Router

evidence.observation: Direct invocations of call_gemini and call_mistral via environment API keys found in emergency alert summary rather than routing via model router.

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert summary to route LLM calls through the centralized model router endpoint.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures policy governance, fallback handling, and latency metrics across LLM calls.
